annotations.title: Crawl a website into the knowledge base

description: Crawl a website and add its pages to the knowledge base. Runs in the background; check on it with list_crawls. Each plan caps the pages per crawl, and asking for more than the cap is refused.

max_pages.description: How many pages to take at most. Capped by the plan.

start_url.description: Where to start. Defaults to the website's own domain.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: start_crawl
title: Crawl a website into the knowledge base
